faq.question: What if the session is not useful for me?
faq.answer: If you show up, engage genuinely, and still feel you got zero value by the end of the call, tell me and I will issue a full refund. No forms, no conditions.

faq.question: Can I reschedule?
faq.answer: Yes. You can reschedule for free up to 12 hours before the session. If you need to cancel entirely, do it at least 24 hours in advance and I will refund you in full.

faq.question: What timezone are the sessions shown in?
faq.answer: All time slots in the booking calendar are automatically converted to your local timezone. No math needed on your end.

faq.question: I am under 18. Can I still book?
faq.answer: Yes. However, data protection regulations require me to collect a parent or guardian email so they are aware of the booking and consent to data processing.

faq.question: Will this help me get an internship?
faq.answer: I cannot guarantee you an internship just by showing up to the call. What I can do is make sure you leave with a clear strategy: how to write better cold emails, what professors and labs actually look for, and exactly what your next steps are. If you execute the plan as discussed, landing a research internship at a prestigious university or institution, including abroad, is absolutely within reach. The strategy is mine. The execution is yours.

faq.question: Why pay when other platforms are free?
faq.answer: Free platforms often have high no-show rates and mentors who show up unprepared. By charging a fee, I limit my intake, read your pre-session form carefully, and commit to delivering a written plan after the call. You get focused time, not a generic chat.
